ms.promise:
The expected output for this milestone is the conclusion of our internal research that will determine exactly how HandleChat and the HandleChat SDK will work.
At the conclusion of this milestone we will publish the exact development framework for HandleChat and the HandleChat SDK, that will demonstrate how it will be built and how it will work.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone is a clear and concise document explaining how HandleChat and HandleChat SDK will work, how they will be built, and how the community can expect to be able to interact with HandleChat once it is released.

ms.promise:
During this milestone our goal is to deploy the first iteration of HandleChat within our private testnet.
We aim to deliver an operational Proof of Concept of the HandleChat application, capable of utilizing a small group (<10) of Handles to chat over separate browsers.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone is an operational, albeit not production ready, first iteration of HandleChat, that will allow us, the ADA Handle team, to internally utilize the first iteration of the protocol to send and receive messages utilizing HandleChat over different browsers.

ms.promise:
We will launch the first iterations of HandleChat and HandleChat SDK on PreProd and Preview.
This means that we will grant the public access to an operational website: https://chat.handle.me, on Preview and PreProd, that will allow the exchange of messages using Handles.
The SDK will also allow partners to integrate to HandleChat on Preview and PreProd, and with that bring HandleChat messaging into their dApps, wallets, etc. It will be up to them to decide how and when to integrate.
ms.criteria: We will launch the first iteration of HandleChat and its SDK on Preview and Preprod. This means that the community will be able to send and receive messages on Preview and PreProd utilizing their Handles. This will be the first public deliverable. The acceptance criteria is, therefore, a basic but operational first version of HandleChat on Preview and PreProd, that will allow the community to send and receive messages utilizing their Handles.

ms.promise: The goal of this milestone is to correct the bugs detected after Preview and PreProd launch and launch HandleChat and its SDK for MainNet. The expected outputs are an operational HandleChat application on MainNet, allowing users to send and receive messages utilizing Handles, while also making available the SDK available for dApps to utilize.
ms.criteria: The acceptance criteria for this milestone are the successful launch of HandleChat and making the SDK available to the community, in an open-source format, listed publicly on GitHub.

ms.promise:
After launching HandleChat on MainNet, we will utilize the feedback from the community, dApp partners, and users to refine and improve the initial version of HandleChat.
We will also utilize this phase to create the public documentation for HandleChat which will include users' manual and also the SDK-integration manual.
We will also deliver Project Catalyst Closeout Report and Project Close Video, as this is a Final Milestone requirement.
ms.criteria:
The acceptance criteria for the two expected outputs, improved documentation and final updates of HandleChat, are the fully operational first iteration of HandleChat that will allow the community to chat utilizing their Handles, while also updating our documentation portal: https://docs.adahandle.com/, with the documentations for HandleChat.
We will also deliver Project Catalyst Closeout Report and Project Close Video, as this is a Final Milestone requirement.
ms.report:
As per one of the reviewer's and community feedback: When you open Handle Chat - You can now see a instructions on how to use HandleChat as soon as you connect your wallet and there are 2 links to Handle documentation within HandleChat so users know exactly what to do and what to expect from it.
Final Milestone Close-out Video: https://youtu.be/AZV3_NonSRA
Close-out Report can be viewed here.
HandleChat is live on mainnet. You can access it here: https://chat.handle.me
All you need is a CIP-30 wallet and a Handle to start using HandleChat. Please note, that once you connect your wallet to the app and you want to start messaging another Handle, as soon as you select the Handle you want to chat with, they will need to accept your connection before you can message them.
Docs for HandleChat: https://docs.handle.me/docs/HandleChat/1_HandleChat
HandleChat SDK: https://github.com/koralabs/handle-chat-sdk
Thank you!
